principles: Host-neutral canonical checkout state matters more than whichever host first produced a commit.
Only fix the observed baseline correctness drift; avoid opportunistic cleanup or refactor.
Tracked code/config/docs may move; local evidence and retired-root warnings remain local/legacy.
Version metadata must be regenerated consistently, not copied blindly when the old lockfile is stale.
drivers: Proofbound must become the active canonical checkout before retired-root guard work continues.
Orchestrate is retired but currently contains the newer 0.3.63 tracked baseline.
Old untracked experiments and evidence must remain out of GitHub-facing proofbound history.

options.name: A: Narrow tracked baseline import from Orchestrate into proofbound
pros: Directly resolves the observed 0.3.60 versus 0.3.63 drift.
Preserves proofbound as the active canonical checkout.
Keeps legacy evidence and retired warnings excluded by explicit path policy.
cons: Requires careful exclusion of stale package-lock metadata and Orchestrate-only local warnings.
Does not normalize migrated B-3523/B-fbb6 branch history in the same story.

options.name: B: Continue retired-root guard work on proofbound 0.3.60
pros: Avoids an intermediate baseline sync story.
cons: Would implement new guard behavior on a stale canonical checkout.
Could overwrite or conflict with newer 0.3.63 CLI behavior already present in retired Orchestrate/global CLI.

options.name: C: Make Orchestrate canonical again
pros: Uses the newest local tracked baseline immediately.
cons: Contradicts the user-approved migration to proofbound.
Reopens the old write entry we are trying to retire.

chosen: A: Narrow tracked baseline import from Orchestrate into proofbound
rationale: Choose the narrow import because it fixes the real baseline correctness issue while preserving proofbound as canonical and avoiding arbitrary cleanup or legacy evidence movement.

preMortem.scenario: Orchestrate retired warning text is copied into proofbound AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
preMortem.trigger: A broad checkout/import includes excluded root docs.
preMortem.consequence: New agents in proofbound are incorrectly told the canonical checkout is retired.
preMortem.mitigation: Exclude AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md from import and verify git status/diff before commit.

preMortem.scenario: Stale Orchestrate package-lock 0.3.49 metadata is copied as-is.
preMortem.trigger: A blind checkout imports package-lock without regeneration.
preMortem.consequence: Proofbound package metadata remains internally inconsistent despite source version 0.3.63.
preMortem.mitigation: Run npm install in proofbound and explicitly verify package-lock root metadata is 0.3.63.

preMortem.scenario: Legacy evidence or untracked experiments become staged in proofbound.
preMortem.trigger: A recursive filesystem copy is used instead of tracked git import.
preMortem.consequence: GitHub-facing proofbound history is polluted with local research/evidence artifacts.
preMortem.mitigation: Use git tracked path import only and verify no .lattice/local-evidence, experiments, docs/story, or tests/fixtures paths are staged.
